_note: The off-ball choice (ADR-049): every player, the goalkeeper included, chooses his act at his own pace. Salience, no die: hold his place = hold_salience; go to a loose ball, or press the opposing carrier = proximity (1 / (1 + d / proximity_ref)) x rank factor; the rank factor is 1 if no teammate is closer, game_reading x second_reader if one is, 0 beyond; challenge = challenge_salience x (0.5 + 0.5 x tackling, or goalkeeping for the keeper), only when the carrier is within the duel's reach: a good tackler commits, a poor one keeps pressing (jockeying). The goalkeeper does not press, and comes out or challenges only inside his penalty area (keeper_box_*, Law 1). With a teammate on the ball (2026-11-13, ADR-051, the family "without the ball"): offer for a pass = offer_salience x proximity to the carrier x (0.5 + 0.5 x game_reading), only when an opponent is within mark_radius_cm of him; he moves offer_step_cm away from that opponent. Run in behind = run_salience x proximity to the last defender's line (run_reach_cm halves it) x the room behind the line (room / run_room_ref_cm, at most 1) x max_speed x (0.5 + 0.5 x game_reading), only when he is ahead of the ball: he runs to the last defender's line, onside_margin_cm short of it. A fast player who reads the game attacks the space; a slow one holds. Offside is not a law of the engine yet (issue #13): the runner stops on the line by his own reading. Marking (2026-11-13, ADR-051): when the opponents have the ball, an outfield player sees the nearest opponent other than the carrier and how many teammates are closer to him; mark = mark_salience x 1 / (1 + d / mark_zone_cm) x the rank factor x (0.5 + 0.5 x game_reading): the nearest defender who reads the game marks him, standing mark_gap_cm goal-side of him (between him and the goal). Reach for a ball passing by (2026-11-13, ADR-051, receive and intercept): a player reaches a ball on the ground within the control radius (reception.json loose_control_radius_cm) x (ball_reach_base + ball_reach_gain x reactivity) / 1000: a reactive player gets a foot to a pass that a slow one watches go by. The nearest player within his own reach takes it. Block (2026-11-13, ADR-051): a shot that passes within an outfield defender's reach for a passing ball (his reactivity) and below block_height_cm is blocked: it comes back at block_rebound_milli of its speed, loose; out over the goal line it is a corner.
_source: Arbitrary, declared, to be calibrated at L3, except keeper_box_depth_cm (16.5 m) and keeper_box_half_width_cm (20.16 m), Law 1.
